    c = LRUCache(2)
    c.put("a", 1)
    assert c.get("a") == 1

    c.put("b", 2)
    c.get("a")
    c.put("c", 3)
    assert c.get("a") == 1
    assert c.get("b") is None

    c.put("a", 1)
    c.put("a", 9)
    assert c.get("a") == 9
